stem:
A farmer is struggling to control the population of a certain insect on his farm. After researching population control techniques, he discovers that a particular bird is a predator of this insect. The farmer purchases a number of these birds and releases them onto his farm.

How might the farmer’s action most likely have a negative impact on the ecosystem?

options.label: F
options.text: The birds will increase biodiversity of native plant species.

options.label: G
options.text: The birds will pollinate native species, increasing genetic variation.

options.label: H
options.text: The birds will consume beneficial insects, as well as the pest species.

options.label: J
options.text: The birds will mate with native birds and create a new species.
